checklist.message: Regular track: title does not contain 'Pilot/פיילוט'.
checklist.suggested_fix: Remove 'Pilot/פיילוט' indicators or change request_type to 'pilot'.

checklist.message: Approval term consistent with request type.
checklist.suggested_fix: Pilot track must request 1 year; regular/colony/continuation 1–4 years (often 3–4).

checklist.message: PI has at least one training certificate recorded.
checklist.suggested_fix: Add at least one entry to pi.training[].

checklist.message: Participant 1 performs procedures and has training.
checklist.suggested_fix: Add at least one training certificate to this participant.

checklist.message: Animals totals match the sum over experiments.
checklist.suggested_fix: Adjust animals_total[].n_total or per-experiment animals.n so that totals equal the sum per (species,strain,sex,genetic_status). Merge duplicate rows with same key.

checklist.message: Experiment 1: CO₂ euthanasia flow & confirmation documented.
checklist.suggested_fix: Specify CO₂ flow rate as '30–70% chamber volume/min from cylinder' AND a confirmation method (e.g. cervical dislocation, thoracotomy).

checklist.message: Experiment 1: oncology block has burden cap and ulceration policy.
checklist.suggested_fix: Fill oncology.tumor_burden_cap (e.g. '≤1500–2000 mm3') and oncology.ulceration_policy (e.g. 'Immediate euthanasia if ulceration appears').
Fill biosafety_infectious_agents: agent_name, BSL_level, PPE, decontamination_SOP, waste_handling, facility_biosafety_approval_id.
Shorten or move methodological detail to later sections.
